items: Weight-loss coaching with a cashback offer
Weight-loss coaching, no offer in the video
product_mix.note: Twenty-one of 34 ads sell weight-loss coaching with a cashback offer, five sell the smart scale, and the other eight sell cheaper plans or a ₹199 review.

series.name: Cashback cheque prop
series.note: The same collage of cheques marked '100 % CASHBACK OFFER' and 'WINNER' runs in 16 ads, while the voice promises 10X cashback and up to 5 lakh rupees.

series.name: Named customer with a starting weight
series.note: Three ads open on a customer's name, town and starting weight over a full-length photo, and two end on the identical 'up to 30% off' card.

series.name: Customer story, same cashback end card
series.note: Nineteen ads hand a customer's story to the same grey-haired man pointing at '10X cashback' and 'first 100 customers only'.

contradictions.text: One ad says 25 kg lost in 90 days and another 28 kg in 6 months, while the small print says a typical user loses 2-3 kg in 4 weeks.
The voice says 10X cashback and up to 5 lakh rupees, the cheques say 100% and show about ₹4,250 to ₹16,000, and another end card says only up to ₹5,00,000.
End cards say 'Offer Valid Till 31st October only', yet all three ads were still listed active on 20 November, 20 to 24 days later.
The smart scale tracks 18 metrics in one ad and 25 in others, and the Amazon page shown inside the 25-metric video still says 18+.
The same woman is 'Malika, lost 35 kgs' in one ad and 'Mallika', 104 kg to 66 kg, which is 38 kg, in another.
